title: Bank fraud alert
code_notification: {bank_short}: Your one-time code is {code}. We will never call or text to ask for this code.

opening: I'll call the number on the back of my card.
after_code: Why do you need a code?
I'm going to call my bank directly.
default: How do I know this is really {bank_short}?
OK, what do I need to do?
I'll check in the official app first.

scam.objective_text: Get the player to read back the one-time code that was just texted to them.

opening.text: {bank_short} Fraud Alert: A {amount} purchase at {merchant} was attempted on your card ending {last4}. Was this you? Reply YES or NO.

scam.key_message: To confirm you're the account holder, I just sent a one-time code to your phone. Please read it back to me so I can cancel the charge.

authority: This is Daniel with the {bank_short} fraud department. I'm looking at an unauthorized attempt on your card ending {last4}.
I'm a verified {bank_short} fraud specialist, and your account has been flagged at the highest priority level.
urgency: The {amount} charge is scheduled to process in the next 10 minutes. We need to verify you right now to stop it.
I can only hold this transaction for a few more minutes. After that it goes through.
fear: If we can't verify you, the {amount} will go through and your account may be frozen while we investigate.
We're also seeing a second login attempt from another state. Someone may already have your details.
trust_building: I completely understand being careful. That's exactly what we want our members to do. I'm here to protect your money.
You're doing the right thing by asking. I've already started blocking the charge on my end, I just need one last step from you.
credential_request: To confirm you're the account holder, I just sent a one-time code to your phone. Please read it back to me so I can cancel the charge.
I only need that 6-digit code we texted you. Once I have it, the charge is cancelled.
suspicious_link: You can also secure your account yourself here: {link}
If it's easier, log in at {link} and the hold will be placed automatically.

verification_call.speaker: bank
verification_call.text: Thanks for calling {bank}. How can I help you today?

verification_call.speaker: player
verification_call.text: I got a text saying someone tried to use my card at {merchant} for {amount}.

verification_call.speaker: bank
verification_call.text: I've checked your account. There's no fraud alert and no pending purchase at {merchant}. That text did not come from us.

verification_call.speaker: bank
verification_call.text: We will never text or call asking for a one-time code. You did the right thing by calling us.

legit.objective_text: Find out whether the player made the {amount} purchase at {merchant}. A YES or NO reply completes it.

opening.text: {bank_short} Fraud Alert: Did you attempt a {amount} purchase at {merchant} on your card ending {last4}? Reply YES or NO.

checkable_details: The attempted purchase was {amount} at {merchant} today at 2:14 PM. You can see it as pending in the {bank_short} app under Card Alerts.
This is alert #{alert_id} on your card ending {last4}. The details are also in your {bank_short} app.
no_credentials_asked: We'll never ask for your PIN, password or a one-time code. A YES or NO reply is all we need.
Just reply YES or NO. Please don't send us any codes or passwords.
invites_verification: If you'd rather confirm with us directly, call the number on the back of your card and mention alert #{alert_id}.
You're welcome to call the number on the back of your card instead. They can see this alert too.
no_pressure: There's no rush. Your card has a temporary hold, so nothing will be charged while you decide.
Take your time. The purchase won't go through until we hear from you.
accepts_no: No problem at all. Feel free to call us instead. We'll keep the hold in place.
That's completely fine. You can handle this through the app or by phone whenever you're ready.
official_channels: You can also review and answer this alert in the official {bank_short} app.
This alert is also in your secure messages when you log in to the {bank_short} app yourself.

verification_call.speaker: bank
verification_call.text: Thanks for calling {bank}. How can I help you today?

verification_call.speaker: player
verification_call.text: I got a text asking if I tried to buy something at {merchant} for {amount}.

verification_call.speaker: bank
verification_call.text: Yes, that's our alert #{alert_id}. We placed a hold on that purchase. Was it you?

verification_call.speaker: bank
verification_call.text: Thanks. I've declined the charge and we'll mail you a new card. Checking with us directly was a smart move.
